items.title: Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 1997
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I see your name come up a lot, along with your brother. And also, Conrad Gotzo.

ctx.x: Yeah, pretty much so. I’ve been honored by the L.A. Jazz Society in 1990 and that was kind of nice, it was kind of unexpected and so apparently I fill the requirements that were necessary, to have been in L.A. for twenty years and have been playing jazz in that area for twenty years. So they honored me that particular day which was kind of nice.
